steps.en: Install and inspect sandbox-off and auto-approval policy before configuring access
steps.zh: 安装并先检查沙箱关闭与自动批准策略

steps.en: Restrict enabled skills and channel access, then submit an office task
steps.zh: 限制启用技能和渠道访问，再提交办公任务

steps.en: Create the session and dispatch execution, including automatic exec-approval paths
steps.zh: 建立会话并执行，命令可能已自动批准

steps.en: Inspect execution records and genuine pending human requests
steps.zh: 检查执行记录与真实待人工处理请求

steps.en: Store messages and display the resulting artifacts
steps.zh: 保存消息并展示生成产物

value.en: Inspect office work and artifacts without assuming every command waits for human approval
value.zh: 审阅办公过程与产物，不假定每条命令都等待人审
